description: Capability for the app's own webviews. Scoped by WEBVIEW label, not window: a capability listing `windows` is granted to EVERY webview of a matching window, and a browser pane is a child webview of `main`, so `windows` here would hand every site you browse this whole permission set the moment its origin resolved as local. Every window TEDI opens is a WebviewWindow, whose webview label equals its window label, so this list is unchanged for them and `browser-*` matches nothing.
